note: Every figure below was read off a source document and then independently re-verified by a second pass that re-opened each source. Corrections that pass forced: the US ICI series is MUTUAL-FUND-ONLY (ETFs excluded) so it is NOT a risk-off signal; the Singapore read was replaced with the verified weekly tracker after a stale monthly line contradicted it; the Korea read was moved off a +3.6% rally day to the latest completed session; and two BofA lines were dropped because their only source carried a self-disclaimer. Markets differ in what they disclose — proxies are badged, and what is simply not published is stated rather than filled in.

Risk-ON for Japanese large caps — the highest-quality flow signal in this panel because JPX publishes actual beneficial-category data, not proxies.

markets.trend: Mainland money turned from buyer to persistent seller of HK equities over the last six sessions, with the selling largest on the most recent day.
markets.interpretation: Direct negative for the HK-tech sleeve (Tencent, Xiaomi, SMIC). Southbound is the only high-frequency conviction signal HK offers, and it has rolled over — the "national team put" that supported HK on 20 Jul is not showing up in Connect flows.
dataGaps: HKEX publishes NO retail-vs-institutional split — its Cash Market Transaction Survey was discontinued (latest edition 2020)
Northbound real-time and daily flows were withdrawn in 2024; only quarterly shareholding remains
Southbound captures mainland money only — it says nothing about international institutional flows into HK

Margin balance is a leverage proxy, not a flow measurement

PROXY, and the stalest line here. Vanda called it the lowest 4-week level since the COVID outbreak.

markets.trend: Asset managers remain heavily net long index futures while leveraged funds are heavily net short — a wide institutional split. Retail buying power has faded to post-COVID lows.
markets.interpretation: Mixed, not risk-off. The headline "$36.5bn of equity outflows" is a mutual-fund-to-ETF migration artefact and should not be read as selling. The genuine signal is positioning: asset managers long, hedge funds short, and retail firepower at multi-year lows — a market with no strong marginal buyer left.
dataGaps: The US publishes NO investor-type flow breakdown — everything here is a proxy
ICI excludes ETFs, which is where most equity flow now goes, so it measures a shrinking slice
CFTC data is 3+ days stale by publication and covers futures positioning, not cash equity flows
Both ICI and CFTC URLs are overwritten weekly — figures are stamped to the retrieval date of 31 Jul 2026

chartNote: Charts show NET flow per period: bars above the zero line are net buying, below is net selling.
